page: Amazon Web Services r8idb.48xlarge is an eighth-generation memory-optimized instance designed for enterprise applications that demand high memory density and extensive local storage. Powered by the AWS Nitro System hypervisor, the server provides 192 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs across 96 physical cores from Intel, operating at clock speeds up to 3.9 GHz with two threads per core. System memory totals 1,536 GB, establishing an 8 GB per vCPU ratio suitable for large-scale in-memory computing.

For I/O performance, the r8idb.48xlarge bundles 11,400 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD instance storage. This substantial local solid-state capacity delivers low latency and elevated I/O throughput directly on the host, avoiding network storage latency. Network performance is provisioned with a 200 Gbps baseline bandwidth, facilitating rapid node-to-node replication, high-volume data ingestion, and unconstrained distributed communication across cloud clusters.

From an operational perspective, the r8idb.48xlarge concentrates extreme resource density into a single host footprint, delivering favorable cost efficiency for consolidating distributed databases or eliminating cluster sprawl. However, because the 11.4 TB NVMe storage is ephemeral instance storage, data persistence requires application-level replication or automated synchronization to persistent storage volumes. Lacking hardware GPU accelerators, the instance is not suited for machine learning training. It is optimally aligned with in-memory caching platforms, enterprise relational databases, big data analytics engines, and real-time transaction processing.
description: Amazon Web Services r8idb.48xlarge is an eighth-generation memory-optimized cloud server built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 192 dedicated Intel x86_64 vCPUs across 96 physical cores running at 3.9 GHz, coupled with 1,536 GB of system RAM for an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU allocation. Storage capabilities include 11,400 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD instance store, paired with 200 Gbps baseline networking throughput. Designed to deliver strong resource consolidation, the instance reduces overhead across heavy-scale deployments while requiring external redundancy strategies to protect ephemeral local storage. Lacking GPU accelerators, the r8idb.48xlarge is purpose-built for memory-bound and I/O-intensive workloads, including enterprise relational databases, large-scale in-memory caching platforms, real-time analytics, and heavy transactional processing pipelines.
